name: kb-mcp
description: The kb-mcp knowledge-base MCP server as a one-plugin marketplace: add this repository as a marketplace and install kb-mcp from it.

plugins.name: kb-mcp
plugins.description: A local, private knowledge-base MCP server over your own folders of Markdown and text notes. Tools kb_search, kb_get, kb_recent, kb_reindex, kb_status over a SQLite index (BM25 via FTS5, optional Ollama embeddings, adaptive rank fusion) that refreshes itself. Stdlib Python 3.8+, nothing leaves the machine.
